subject: Bluesummit GCP Private Offer — Term uplift + onboarding checklist
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Clarke <emma@bluesummit.ai>, procurement@bluesummit.ai
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Bluesummit GCP Private Offer — Term uplift + onboarding checklist

Emma / Procurement team,

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Per our call, we've prepared a GCP Private Offer that transitions BlueSummit from a 12-month annual commitment to an 18-month term with a 35% capacity uplift on the active cluster reservation. The attached PDF is the private offer draft (v2) and I've included an onboarding/acceptance checklist to make the acceptance window and billing tranches explicit.

Key summary:
- Term: 18 months (start on signature date)
- Committed capacity: +35% to current baseline (applies to GPU hours in us-west1)
- Pricing: tiered unit pricing with a 12-month ramp, then steady rate from month 13
- Invoicing: two tranches — 60% upfront, 40% at month 12 (we can discuss alternative staggers)
- Acceptance: standard acceptance checklist (integration smoke tests + usage sampling)

Ask: Please confirm the procurement contact to route the private offer to (DocuSign-ready) and whether the PO will cover the full upfront tranche or if you need us to split invoices across purchase orders. Once I have confirmation we'll route the private offer through GCP and trigger the DocuSign flow.

Attachments: BlueSummit_GCP_PrivateOffer_v2.pdf, acceptance-onboarding-checklist.xlsx, SOC2-summary-2028.pdf

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

---

From: Emma Clarke <emma@bluesummit.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@bluesummit.ai
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 11:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Bluesummit GCP Private Offer — Term uplift + onboarding checklist

Karthik,

Thanks — this looks good on first pass. Procurement here (procurement@bluesummit.ai) will own the PO flow. A couple notes from our side:
- We need the invoice schedule documented on the private offer (we prefer three tranches if possible: 40% / 30% / 30% aligned with project milestones).
- Legal will want to narrow the SLA exception window for planned maintenance to 48 hours.
- For acceptance, our infra team will run the smoke tests in staging and needs at least two weeks' notice for windowing.

I'll loop in billing and legal from our side later today if any other items surface. If you can add the three-tranche option to the offer PDF that'd be helpful.

Emma Clarke
Head of Partnerships, BlueSummit.ai
emma@bluesummit.ai | +1 617-555-0199

Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Bluesummit GCP Private Offer — Tranche options & billing notes

Karthik / Kim —

Thanks for the heads-up. Ben from Finance here. A few operational notes:
- We can support a 40/30/30 tranche schedule, but need the PO to explicitly reference the contract/offer ID so we can apply the upfront credit to the customer's billing account.
- For multi-PO customers: ask procurement to include the primary PO number and, if they will use separate POs for later tranches, include a reference map (e.g., PO#1 -> tranche1, PO#2 -> tranche2).
- Tax/VAT: if BlueSummit is invoiced via a US entity we will issue USD invoices; if EU/EUR entity we need VAT specifics ahead of execution.

I'll prepare the billing memo and a short acceptance guide that maps checklist items to invoice triggers. Attaching a one-page stub here (will upload full memo to Drive).

Ben Carter
Revenue Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 Sep 2028 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Bluesummit GCP Private Offer — Legal redlines and acceptance window

Team,

Reviewed the private offer PDF. Legal requests the following redlines before final routing:
1) Shorten Redwood's planned maintenance notification to 7 days with an SLA credit if maintenance causes >10% degradation in latency for >2 hours.
2) Clarify data residency: confirm that customer data is only stored in us-west1 unless otherwise agreed (BlueSummit asked about cross-region replication).
3) Add a standard audit clause allowing BlueSummit one SOC2 evidence pull per 12 months (we'll provide the summary + evidence bundle).

Operational ask: add DocuSign comment fields for 'invoice PO reference for tranche' so procurement can fill the PO# mapping inline.

Once Ben confirms invoice triggers mapping, I'll prepare the legal cover letter and we can send final to Emma to sign.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Contracts Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Subject: Final: Bluesummit GCP Private Offer (DocuSign) — next steps

Emma / Procurement team,

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the tranche preference — we've updated the private offer to include the 40/30/30 invoice schedule and incorporated the legal/finance asks (maintenance notification window, data residency clause, and SOC2 evidence language). The updated PDF is attached and I've pushed the DocuSign packet to the link below so procurement can populate PO references inline.

Next steps:
1) Procurement to populate PO# mapping in DocuSign and sign (expected 48–72 hours).
2) We will submit the private offer to GCP once signed and confirm marketplace activation ETA (typically 2–3 business days after GCP acceptance).
3) Ben will raise the invoice for tranche 1 within 24 hours of marketplace activation; onboarding/runbook call to be scheduled for the two-week acceptance window Emma requested.
